name: Arcane Rhythm
description: Fuels the destructive power of your group members, allowing them to strike with Arcane Rhythm Effect II, which deals 26072 damage when they cast a damaging spell up to level 125, or a chance to strike with Arcane Rhythm Strike II, which deals 23986 damage, when making melee attacks. Lasts for 12 seconds or until you have enhanced 4 spells.
